data.message: Thank you for the opportunity under RFQ-ORN-2026-0917. For 50,000 units of 32-bit automotive-grade microcontrollers (AEC-Q100 Grade 1) we can offer USD 4.60 per unit, delivery in 42 days, Net 15 payment terms, 92.0% on-time-in-full, LDs of 0.10% per day of delay, an LD cap of 3.0% of contract value and a 12-month warranty. This reflects the capacity we are reserving for you.

Thank you for the quote. To make this work for Orion Mobility Ltd. we need USD 3.40 per unit, delivery in 14 days, Net 45 payment terms, 99.0% on-time-in-full, LDs of 1.00% per day of delay, an LD cap of 15.0% of contract value and a 24-month warranty. Our priorities are unit price and delivery lead time.

Meeting you part-way, we are moving warranty to 24 months and otif service level to 94.2%. We need to hold unit price at USD 4.60 given the capacity we are reserving for you. If you can move on late-delivery ld rate, we can close quickly.
